# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities to repository_security@icloud.com instead of using the issue tracker.

Include the following details:
- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Suggested fix (if any)

We appreciate your responsible disclosure and will acknowledge your report within 48 hours.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Security Updates

We release security patches immediately when a vulnerability is discovered.
